random-wheel/features/draw_history: Draw history keeps track of past results
random-wheel/how_to_use/step1: Type one option per line in the input area.
random-wheel/how_to_use/step2: Enable "De-duplicate" or "Remove the winner after each draw" if needed.
random-wheel/how_to_use/step3: Click the button in the center of the wheel to spin it.
random-wheel/how_to_use/step4: The pointer stops on the winning option, and the result is added to the draw history.

Pizza
Sushi

Dumplings
random-wheel/input/limit: Only the first 100 options are used.
random-wheel/input/placeholder: Enter one option per line, e.g. names, dishes, tasks...
random-wheel/note: Enter a list of options, spin a colorful random wheel, and let it pick one for you.
random-wheel/options/remove_winner: Remove the winner after each draw
random-wheel/result/empty: Add at least one option to spin the wheel.
random-wheel/result/idle: Click the button in the center to spin!
